item.title: Oaklandside’s Ashley McBride, Callie Rhoades receive First Amendment award
item.description: Oaklandside’s Ashley McBride, Callie Rhoades receive First Amendment award The pair are being honored by the First Amendment Coalition with its Free Speech and Open Government Award for their reporting last year on the lead crisis in Oakland public schools.

item.title: Cut homelessness by 50% in Oakland? A new plan says it’s possible
item.description: Cut homelessness by 50% in Oakland? A new plan says it’s possible Mayor Lee’s homelessness office has issued a bold report. But funding is short, and there’s a different plan already on the table.

item.title: Alameda Health System layoffs deferred while county explores options
item.description: Alameda Health System layoffs deferred while county explores options A plan to slash 188 health care jobs at the East Bay’s safety net hospital would heavily impact mental health programs. County leaders hope to avoid this.
